chunks: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazee' from Salih ibn Uqbah from Bashir al-Dahhan from Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) who said:
"Whoever visits the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) on the first day of Rajab, God will certainly forgive him."
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting Imam Husayn's grave on the first of Rajab?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq underscores the unique spiritual merit of visiting Imam al-Husayn’s shrine on the first of Rajab, a date often associated with the beginning of the month of the Prophet’s ascension and divine mercy. The promise of 'complete forgiveness' (ghufran al-battah) highlights the intercessory power of the Ahl al-Bayt and the transformative nature of ziyarah in Shia piety, linking physical pilgrimage to spiritual purification.
